name: Deniz Kabuğu
scene: A scallop seashell with broad alternating fan ribs, surrounded by flowing ocean bands.
notes: Target 25–35 panes. Shell uses coral and amber exclusively; ocean uses blue and turquoise. Generated with clai image using vitray_poppies.png as style reference and seashell-silhouette.webp as subject reference, then regenerated once after visual inspection. Final image inspected: opaque white exterior, closed oval rim, recognizable scalloped shell, no obvious loose line ends. Remaining concerns for tracing: slight tonal variation persists rather than perfectly flat fills; two central amber ribs taper narrowly at the base, and the lower-centre wave meeting and some upper wave junctions need geometry review for crowded contacts. Some blue background neighbours may merge. Design sheet only; not audited playable geometry.
